name: web-dark-radar-chart-card-with-blue-and-violet-glowing-strokes
title: Dark card 'Glowing Multiple Stroke' with a red -5.2% badge and a radar chart of two glowing polygons over months
whatItIs: A black rounded card with a bold title, a red pill '-5.2%' with a down arrow, a grey subtitle and a radar chart with dotted grid rings, month labels around the edge and two glowing polygons, one blue and one violet.
whatItMeans: Technical and elegant; a soft glow makes thin data lines feel luminous.
techniques: Draw multiple series as glowing strokes.
Show change in a small red pill.
Place month labels on the perimeter.

vocabulary.definition: A chart plotting values on radial axes.
A line with a soft luminous halo.
A capsule showing change with an arrow.
Labels placed around a circular chart.
